description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa along left wall facing the central coffee table and TV; armchairs flanking on either side of the coffee table. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: families needing ample storage — the layout has no wardrobes or dedicated storage room; remote workers requiring a home office — no desk space in either bedroom; large households — only two bedrooms with limited sleeping capacity; anyone needing a private bathroom off the master — single shared bathroom only.
